segments.src: Household consumption is the largest piece of the economy, accounting for roughly two-thirds of GDP.
segments.tr: La consommation des ménages est la plus grande partie de l'économie, représentant environ les deux tiers du PIB.

segments.src: Analysts look at:
segments.tr: Les analystes examinent :

segments.src: - **Goods versus services.** Spending on services such as travel, dining and health care tends to be steadier than spending on durable goods like cars and appliances.
segments.tr: - **Biens par rapport aux services.** Les dépenses en services tels que les voyages, la restauration et les soins de santé ont tendance à être plus régulières que les dépenses en biens durables comme les voitures et les appareils électroménagers.

segments.src: - **Real versus nominal.** The GDP figures are adjusted for inflation, so strong nominal spending can still translate into modest real growth if prices rose quickly.
segments.tr: - **Réel par rapport au nominal.** Les chiffres du PIB sont ajustés pour l'inflation, de sorte qu'une forte dépense nominale peut toujours se traduire par une modeste croissance réelle si les prix ont augmenté rapidement.

segments.src: - **Momentum within the quarter.** A strong July followed by a weaker September tells a different story than the reverse, even if the quarterly average looks the same.
segments.tr: - **Élan au cours du trimestre.** Un mois de juillet fort suivi d'un mois de septembre plus faible raconte une histoire différente que l'inverse, même si la moyenne trimestrielle semble la même.

segments.src: ### 2. Business investment
segments.tr: ### 2. Investissement des entreprises

segments.src: Also called nonresidential fixed investment, this category covers spending on equipment, software, intellectual property and structures.
segments.tr: Également appelé investissement fixe non résidentiel, cette catégorie couvre les dépenses en équipements, logiciels, propriété intellectuelle et structures.

segments.src: It is smaller than consumption but more volatile, and it often signals how confident companies feel about future demand.
segments.tr: Il est plus petit que la consommation mais plus volatil, et il signale souvent la confiance des entreprises dans la demande future.

segments.src: Pay attention to whether growth is concentrated in one area, such as technology equipment or data-center construction, or broadly shared across sectors.
segments.tr: Faites attention à savoir si la croissance est concentrée dans un seul domaine, comme les équipements technologiques ou la construction de centres de données, ou largement partagée entre les secteurs.

segments.src: Residential investment, meaning home building and renovation, is tracked separately and tends to be sensitive to mortgage rates.
segments.tr: L'investissement résidentiel, c'est-à-dire la construction et la rénovation de logements, est suivi séparément et a tendance à être sensible aux taux hypothécaires.

segments.src: ### 3. Trade
segments.tr: ### 3. Commerce

segments.src: Net exports, which are exports minus imports, can swing the headline number sharply from one quarter to the next.
segments.tr: Les exportations nettes, qui sont les exportations moins les importations, peuvent faire osciller brusquement le chiffre global d'un trimestre à l'autre.

segments.src: Imports subtract from GDP because they represent spending on goods produced elsewhere, so a surge in imports can pull down the topline even when domestic demand is healthy.
segments.tr: Les importations soustraient au PIB car elles représentent des dépenses en biens produits ailleurs, de sorte qu'une poussée des importations peut faire baisser le chiffre d'affaires même lorsque la demande intérieure est saine.

segments.src: Shifts in tariffs, shipping patterns and company stockpiling can make this component especially noisy.
segments.tr: Les changements dans les tarifs douaniers, les schémas d'expédition et le stockage des entreprises peuvent rendre cette composante particulièrement bruyante.

segments.src: Many economists therefore treat a single quarter's trade contribution with caution.
segments.tr: De nombreux économistes traitent donc la contribution commerciale d'un seul trimestre avec prudence.

segments.src: ### 4. Government spending
segments.tr: ### 4. Dépenses publiques

segments.src: Federal, state and local purchases round out the total.
segments.tr: Les achats fédéraux, étatiques et locaux complètent le total.

segments.src: These figures are usually less dramatic, but defense outlays, infrastructure projects and the timing of budget decisions can move them noticeably.
segments.tr: Ces chiffres sont généralement moins dramatiques, mais les dépenses de défense, les projets d'infrastructure et le calendrier des décisions budgétaires peuvent les faire bouger de manière notable.

segments.src: ## A useful shortcut: "final sales to private domestic purchasers"
segments.tr: ## Un raccourci utile : « les ventes finales aux acheteurs domestiques privés »

segments.src: Because trade, inventories and government spending can add noise, many forecasters also watch a narrower measure that strips them out.
segments.tr: Étant donné que le commerce, les stocks et les dépenses publiques peuvent ajouter du bruit, de nombreux prévisionnistes surveillent également une mesure plus étroite qui les exclut.

segments.src: Final sales to private domestic purchasers combines consumer spending and private fixed investment.
segments.tr: Les ventes finales aux acheteurs domestiques privés combinent les dépenses de consommation et l'investissement fixe privé.

segments.src: It is often considered a cleaner read on underlying demand, and it has historically been a better guide to where the economy is heading than the headline figure alone.
segments.tr: Elle est souvent considérée comme une lecture plus claire de la demande sous-jacente, et elle a historiquement été un meilleur guide de l'orientation de l'économie que le chiffre global seul.

segments.src: Inventories deserve a mention as well.
segments.tr: Les stocks méritent également d'être mentionnés.

segments.src: Changes in the stock of unsold goods can add to or subtract from growth in any given quarter, and those swings often reverse the following quarter.
segments.tr: Les variations du stock de biens non vendus peuvent ajouter ou soustraire de la croissance au cours d'un trimestre donné, et ces oscillations s'inversent souvent le trimestre suivant.

segments.src: ## Why the headline number gets revised
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi le chiffre global est révisé

segments.src: It is common for the first estimate to change, sometimes by a meaningful amount.
segments.tr: Il est courant que la première estimation change, parfois de manière significative.

segments.src: Several factors explain this:
segments.tr: Plusieurs facteurs expliquent cela :

segments.src: - **Incomplete data.** The advance estimate relies on partial surveys and early indicators that are updated later.
segments.tr: - **Données incomplètes.** L'estimation avancée s'appuie sur des enquêtes partielles et des indicateurs précoces qui sont mis à jour plus tard.

segments.src: - **Seasonal and statistical adjustments.** Methods are refined as more information arrives.
segments.tr: - **Ajustements saisonniers et statistiques.** Les méthodes sont affinées au fur과 et à mesure que de nouvelles informations arrivent.

segments.src: - **Annual and comprehensive updates.** The BEA periodically revises historical figures, which can alter the picture of growth well after the fact.
segments.tr: - **Mises à jour annuelles et globales.** Le BEA révise périodiquement les chiffres historiques, ce qui peut modifier l'image de la croissance bien après coup.

segments.src: A revision does not mean the original number was careless.
segments.tr: Une révision ne signifie pas que le nombre initial était imprudent.

segments.src: It reflects the tradeoff between speed and completeness.
segments.tr: Il reflète le compromis entre la vitesse et l'exhaustivité.

segments.src: Users of the data generally accept an imperfect early read because timely information is valuable.
segments.tr: Les utilisateurs des données acceptent généralement une lecture précoce imparfaite parce que l'information opportune est précieuse.

segments.src: The practical takeaway is to treat the first figure as a reasonable estimate with a margin of error, not a final verdict.
segments.tr: Le point à retenir est de traiter le premier chiffre comme une estimation raisonnable avec une marge d'erreur, et non comme un verdict final.

segments.src: ## Why the timing matters
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi le calendrier compte

segments.src: The release lands in a busy stretch of the calendar.
segments.tr: La publication arrive dans une période chargée du calendrier.

segments.src: **The Federal Reserve.** Policymakers weigh growth, inflation and the labor market when deciding on interest rates.
segments.tr: **La Réserve fédérale.** Les décideurs pèsent la croissance, l'inflation et le marché du travail lorsqu'ils décident des taux d'intérêt.

segments.src: A strong or weak GDP reading can shape the discussion, though the Fed typically looks at a wide range of data rather than a single report.
segments.tr: Une lecture forte ou faible du PIB peut façonner la discussion, bien que la Fed examine généralement un large éventail de données plutôt qu'un seul rapport.

segments.src: **The midterm elections.** Economic conditions are a regular theme in campaigns.
segments.tr: **Les élections de mi-mandat.** Les conditions économiques sont un thème régulier dans les campagnes.

segments.src: Candidates and commentators on all sides tend to interpret the numbers through their own lens, which is one more reason to look at the components rather than the headline alone.
segments.tr: Les candidats et les commentateurs de tous bords ont tendance à interpréter les chiffres à travers leur propre prisme, ce qui est une raison de plus d'examiner les composants plutôt que le titre seul.

segments.src: ## How to read the report like an analyst
segments.tr: ## Comment lire le rapport comme un analyste

segments.src: 1. **Look past the headline.** Check the contributions from consumption, investment, trade and inventories.
segments.tr: 1. **Regarder au-delà du titre.** Vérifiez les contributions de la consommation, de l'investissement, du commerce et des stocks.

segments.src: 2. **Compare with recent quarters.** One report is a data point, not a trend.
segments.tr: 2. **Comparer avec les trimestres récents.** Un rapport est un point de données, pas une tendance.

segments.src: 3. **Watch the revisions.** Compare the advance estimate with later versions to understand how reliable early readings have been.
segments.tr: 3. **Surveiller les révisions.** Comparez l'estimation avancée avec les versions ultérieures pour comprendre à quel point les lectures précoces ont été fiables.

segments.src: 4. **Pair GDP with other indicators.** Employment, inflation, retail sales and income data provide context that GDP alone cannot.
segments.tr: 4. **Associer le PIB à d'autres indicateurs.** L'emploi, l'inflation, les ventes au détail et les données sur le revenu fournissent un contexte que le PIB seul ne peut pas offrir.

segments.src: 5. **Remember that GDP is a backward-looking measure.** It describes what already happened, not what comes next.
segments.tr: 5. **Se rappeler que le PIB est une mesure rétrospective.** Il décrit ce qui s'est déjà produit, pas ce qui va suivre.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## L'essentiel

segments.src: The advance estimate of third-quarter GDP offers a valuable first look at the economy's health, but it is a snapshot, not a final grade.
segments.tr: L'estimation avancée du PIB du troisième trimestre offre un premier regard précieux sur la santé de l'économie, mais c'est un instantané, pas une note finale.

segments.src: The most informative details sit beneath the headline, in how households spent, how businesses invested and how trade shifted.
segments.tr: Les détails les plus instructifs se trouvent sous le titre, dans la façon dont les ménages ont dépensé, dont les entreprises ont investi et dont le commerce a évolué.

segments.src: Readers who focus on those components, and who keep in mind that revisions are normal, will come away with a clearer and more balanced understanding of where the economy stands.
segments.tr: Les lecteurs qui se concentrent sur ces composants, et qui gardent à l'esprit que les révisions sont normales, repartiront avec une compréhension plus claire et plus équilibrée de la situation de l'économie.

pt.title: O PIB do terceiro trimestre está chegando: o que a primeira leitura sobre o crescimento nos dirá sobre a economia

segments.src: The first official estimate of third-quarter economic growth is due in the final days of October, arriving just ahead of the Federal Reserve's next policy meeting and the November midterm elections.
segments.tr: A primeira estimativa oficial do crescimento econômico do terceiro trimestre está prevista para os últimos dias de outubro, chegando logo antes da próxima reunião de política monetária do Federal Reserve e das eleições de meio de mandato de novembro.

segments.src: The release is one of the most closely watched data points of the year.
segments.tr: O lançamento é um dos dados mais observados do ano.

segments.src: It is also one of the most frequently misread.
segments.tr: É também um dos mais frequentemente mal interpretados.

segments.src: This guide explains what the number measures, which components deserve the most attention, and why the first figure is only the opening chapter of a longer story.
segments.tr: Este guia explica o que o número mede, quais componentes merecem mais atenção e por que o primeiro valor é apenas o capítulo inicial de uma história mais longa.

segments.src: ## What the "advance estimate" actually is
segments.tr: ## O que é, na verdade, a "estimativa antecipada"

segments.src: Gross domestic product, or GDP, is the broadest measure of the goods and services produced in the United States.
segments.tr: O produto interno bruto, ou PIB, é a medida mais ampla de bens e serviços produzidos nos Estados Unidos.

segments.src: The Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA), part of the Commerce Department, publishes it every quarter, and the headline figure is typically presented as an annualized rate.
segments.tr: O Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA), parte do Departamento de Comércio, publica-o a cada trimestre, e o número principal é normalmente apresentado como uma taxa anualizada.

segments.src: That means the quarterly change is expressed as if the pace continued for a full year.
segments.tr: Isso significa que a variação trimestral é expressa como se o ritmo continuasse por um ano inteiro.

segments.src: The first release is called the **advance estimate**.
segments.tr: O primeiro lançamento é chamado de **estimativa antecipada**.

segments.src: It arrives about a month after the quarter ends, which means it is built on incomplete information.
segments.tr: Ele chega cerca de um mês após o término do trimestre, o que significa que é construído com informações incompletas.

segments.src: Some source data are still being collected, and the BEA fills gaps with projections and statistical methods.
segments.tr: Alguns dados de origem ainda estão sendo coletados, e o BEA preenche as lacunas com projeções e métodos estatísticos.

segments.src: Two later updates, known as the second and third estimates, follow in the subsequent two months as more data come in.
segments.tr: Duas atualizações posteriores, conhecidas como segunda e terceira estimativas, seguem nos dois meses subsequentes à medida que mais dados chegam.

segments.src: ## The four building blocks
segments.tr: ## Os quatro blocos de construção

segments.src: GDP is usually broken into four categories.
segments.tr: O PIB é geralmente dividido em quatro categorias.

segments.src: Understanding each one makes the headline number far more useful.
segments.tr: Entender cada uma delas torna o número principal muito mais útil.

segments.src: ### 1. Consumer spending
segments.tr: ### 1. Gastos do consumidor

segments.src: Household consumption is the largest piece of the economy, accounting for roughly two-thirds of GDP.
segments.tr: O consumo das famílias é a maior parte da economia, representando cerca de dois terços do PIB.

segments.src: Analysts look at:
segments.tr: Os analistas observam:

segments.src: - **Goods versus services.** Spending on services such as travel, dining and health care tends to be steadier than spending on durable goods like cars and appliances.
segments.tr: - **Bens versus serviços.** Os gastos com serviços, como viagens, alimentação e saúde, tendem a ser mais estáveis do que os gastos com bens duráveis, como carros e eletrodomésticos.

segments.src: - **Real versus nominal.** The GDP figures are adjusted for inflation, so strong nominal spending can still translate into modest real growth if prices rose quickly.
segments.tr: - **Real versus nominal.** Os números do PIB são ajustados pela inflação, portanto, gastos nominais fortes ainda podem se traduzir em um crescimento real modesto se os preços subirem rapidamente.

segments.src: - **Momentum within the quarter.** A strong July followed by a weaker September tells a different story than the reverse, even if the quarterly average looks the same.
segments.tr: - **Momentum dentro do trimestre.** Um mês de julho forte seguido por um setembro mais fraco conta uma história diferente do inverso, mesmo que a média trimestral pareça a mesma.

segments.src: ### 2. Business investment
segments.tr: ### 2. Investimento empresarial

segments.src: Also called nonresidential fixed investment, this category covers spending on equipment, software, intellectual property and structures.
segments.tr: Também chamado de investimento fixo não residencial, esta categoria cobre gastos com equipamentos, software, propriedade intelectual e estruturas.

segments.src: It is smaller than consumption but more volatile, and it often signals how confident companies feel about future demand.
segments.tr: É menor que o consumo, mas mais volátil, e muitas vezes sinaliza o quão confiantes as empresas se sentem em relação à demanda futura.

segments.src: Pay attention to whether growth is concentrated in one area, such as technology equipment or data-center construction, or broadly shared across sectors.
segments.tr: Preste atenção se o crescimento está concentrado em uma área, como equipamentos de tecnologia ou construção de data centers, ou se é amplamente compartilhado entre os setores.

segments.src: Residential investment, meaning home building and renovation, is tracked separately and tends to be sensitive to mortgage rates.
segments.tr: O investimento residencial, ou seja, construção e reforma de casas, é rastreado separadamente e tende a ser sensível às taxas de hipoteca.

segments.src: ### 3. Trade
segments.tr: ### 3. Comércio

segments.src: Net exports, which are exports minus imports, can swing the headline number sharply from one quarter to the next.
segments.tr: As exportações líquidas, que são exportações menos importações, podem oscilar o número principal drasticamente de um trimestre para o outro.

segments.src: Imports subtract from GDP because they represent spending on goods produced elsewhere, so a surge in imports can pull down the topline even when domestic demand is healthy.
segments.tr: As importações subtraem do PIB porque representam gastos com bens produzidos em outros lugares, portanto, um aumento nas importações pode reduzir o resultado final mesmo quando a demanda doméstica está saudável.

segments.src: Shifts in tariffs, shipping patterns and company stockpiling can make this component especially noisy.
segments.tr: Mudanças nas tarifas, padrões de envio e estoques das empresas podem tornar esse componente especialmente ruidoso.

segments.src: Many economists therefore treat a single quarter's trade contribution with caution.
segments.tr: Muitos economistas, portanto, tratam a contribuição comercial de um único trimestre com cautela.

segments.src: ### 4. Government spending
segments.tr: ### 4. Gastos do governo

segments.src: Federal, state and local purchases round out the total.
segments.tr: Compras federais, estaduais e locais completam o total.

segments.src: These figures are usually less dramatic, but defense outlays, infrastructure projects and the timing of budget decisions can move them noticeably.
segments.tr: Esses números geralmente são menos dramáticos, mas os gastos com defesa, projetos de infraestrutura e o cronograma das decisões orçamentárias podem movê-los visivelmente.

segments.src: ## A useful shortcut: "final sales to private domestic purchasers"
segments.tr: ## Um atalho útil: "vendas finais para compradores domésticos privados"

segments.src: Because trade, inventories and government spending can add noise, many forecasters also watch a narrower measure that strips them out.
segments.tr: Como o comércio, os estoques e os gastos do governo podem adicionar ruído, muitos analistas também observam uma medida mais restrita que os exclui.

segments.src: Final sales to private domestic purchasers combines consumer spending and private fixed investment.
segments.tr: As vendas finais para compradores domésticos privados combinam gastos do consumidor e investimento fixo privado.

segments.src: It is often considered a cleaner read on underlying demand, and it has historically been a better guide to where the economy is heading than the headline figure alone.
segments.tr: É frequentemente considerada uma leitura mais clara da demanda subjacente, e tem sido historicamente um guia melhor para onde a economia está indo do que o número principal isoladamente.

segments.src: Inventories deserve a mention as well.
segments.tr: Os estoques também merecem uma menção.

segments.src: Changes in the stock of unsold goods can add to or subtract from growth in any given quarter, and those swings often reverse the following quarter.
segments.tr: Mudanças no estoque de bens não vendidos podem adicionar ou subtrair do crescimento em qualquer trimestre, e essas oscilações muitas vezes se revertem no trimestre seguinte.

segments.src: ## Why the headline number gets revised
segments.tr: ## Por que o número principal é revisado

segments.src: It is common for the first estimate to change, sometimes by a meaningful amount.
segments.tr: É comum que a primeira estimativa mude, às vezes por uma quantia significativa.

segments.src: Several factors explain this:
segments.tr: Vários fatores explicam isso:

segments.src: - **Incomplete data.** The advance estimate relies on partial surveys and early indicators that are updated later.
segments.tr: - **Dados incompletos.** A estimativa antecipada baseia-se em pesquisas parciais e indicadores iniciais que são atualizados posteriormente.

segments.src: - **Seasonal and statistical adjustments.** Methods are refined as more information arrives.
segments.tr: - **Ajustes sazonais e estatísticos.** Os métodos são refinados à medida que mais informações chegam.

segments.src: - **Annual and comprehensive updates.** The BEA periodically revises historical figures, which can alter the picture of growth well after the fact.
segments.tr: - **Atualizações anuais e abrangentes.** O BEA revisa periodicamente os números históricos, o que pode alterar o quadro do crescimento muito depois do fato.

segments.src: A revision does not mean the original number was careless.
segments.tr: Uma revisão não significa que o número original foi descuidado.

segments.src: It reflects the tradeoff between speed and completeness.
segments.tr: Reflete a troca entre velocidade e completude.

segments.src: Users of the data generally accept an imperfect early read because timely information is valuable.
segments.tr: Os usuários dos dados geralmente aceitam uma leitura inicial imperfeita porque informações oportunas são valiosas.

segments.src: The practical takeaway is to treat the first figure as a reasonable estimate with a margin of error, not a final verdict.
segments.tr: A conclusão prática é tratar o primeiro valor como uma estimativa razoável com uma margem de erro, não como um veredito final.

segments.src: ## Why the timing matters
segments.tr: ## Por que o momento importa

segments.src: The release lands in a busy stretch of the calendar.
segments.tr: O lançamento ocorre em um período movimentado do calendário.

segments.src: **The Federal Reserve.** Policymakers weigh growth, inflation and the labor market when deciding on interest rates.
segments.tr: **O Federal Reserve.** Os formuladores de políticas pesam o crescimento, a inflação e o mercado de trabalho ao decidir sobre as taxas de juros.

segments.src: A strong or weak GDP reading can shape the discussion, though the Fed typically looks at a wide range of data rather than a single report.
segments.tr: Uma leitura forte ou fraca do PIB pode moldar a discussão, embora o Fed normalmente observe uma ampla gama de dados em vez de um único relatório.

segments.src: **The midterm elections.** Economic conditions are a regular theme in campaigns.
segments.tr: **As eleições de meio de mandato.** As condições econômicas são um tema regular nas campanhas.

segments.src: Candidates and commentators on all sides tend to interpret the numbers through their own lens, which is one more reason to look at the components rather than the headline alone.
segments.tr: Candidatos e comentaristas de todos os lados tendem a interpretar os números através de suas próprias lentes, o que é mais uma razão para olhar para os componentes em vez do número principal isoladamente.

segments.src: ## How to read the report like an analyst
segments.tr: ## Como ler o relatório como um analista

segments.src: 1. **Look past the headline.** Check the contributions from consumption, investment, trade and inventories.
segments.tr: 1. **Olhe além do número principal.** Verifique as contribuições do consumo, investimento, comércio e estoques.

segments.src: 2. **Compare with recent quarters.** One report is a data point, not a trend.
segments.tr: 2. **Compare com trimestres recentes.** Um relatório é um ponto de dados, não uma tendência.

segments.src: 3. **Watch the revisions.** Compare the advance estimate with later versions to understand how reliable early readings have been.
segments.tr: 3. **Observe as revisões.** Compare a estimativa antecipada com versões posteriores para entender quão confiáveis têm sido as leituras iniciais.

segments.src: 4. **Pair GDP with other indicators.** Employment, inflation, retail sales and income data provide context that GDP alone cannot.
segments.tr: 4. **Combine o PIB com outros indicadores.** Dados de emprego, inflação, vendas no varejo e renda fornecem um contexto que o PIB sozinho não consegue.

segments.src: 5. **Remember that GDP is a backward-looking measure.** It describes what already happened, not what comes next.
segments.tr: 5. **Lembre-se de que o PIB é uma medida que olha para o passado.** Ele descreve o que já aconteceu, não o que virá a seguir.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## A conclusão

segments.src: The advance estimate of third-quarter GDP offers a valuable first look at the economy's health, but it is a snapshot, not a final grade.
segments.tr: A estimativa antecipada do PIB do terceiro trimestre oferece uma primeira visão valiosa da saúde da economia, mas é um instantâneo, não uma nota final.

segments.src: The most informative details sit beneath the headline, in how households spent, how businesses invested and how trade shifted.
segments.tr: Os detalhes mais informativos estão abaixo do número principal, em como as famílias gastaram, como as empresas investiram e como o comércio mudou.

segments.src: Readers who focus on those components, and who keep in mind that revisions are normal, will come away with a clearer and more balanced understanding of where the economy stands.
segments.tr: Os leitores que se concentram nesses componentes, e que mantêm em mente que as revisões são normais, sairão com uma compreensão mais clara e equilibrada de onde a economia se encontra.

segments.src: It is also one of the most frequently misread.
segments.tr: Ini juga salah satu yang paling sering disalahartikan.

segments.src: This guide explains what the number measures, which components deserve the most attention, and why the first figure is only the opening chapter of a longer story.
segments.tr: Panduan ini menjelaskan apa yang diukur oleh angka tersebut, komponen mana yang paling patut diperhatikan, dan mengapa angka pertama hanyalah bab pembuka dari cerita yang lebih panjang.

segments.src: ## What the "advance estimate" actually is
segments.tr: ## Apa sebenarnya "estimasi awal" itu

segments.src: Gross domestic product, or GDP, is the broadest measure of the goods and services produced in the United States.
segments.tr: Produk domestik bruto, atau PDB, adalah ukuran terluas dari barang dan jasa yang diproduksi di Amerika Serikat.

segments.src: The Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA), part of the Commerce Department, publishes it every quarter, and the headline figure is typically presented as an annualized rate.
segments.tr: Biro Analisis Ekonomi (BEA), bagian dari Departemen Perdagangan, menerbitkannya setiap kuartal, dan angka utama biasanya disajikan sebagai tingkat tahunan.

segments.src: That means the quarterly change is expressed as if the pace continued for a full year.
segments.tr: Itu berarti perubahan kuartalan dinyatakan seolah-olah laju tersebut berlanjut selama satu tahun penuh.

segments.src: The first release is called the **advance estimate**.
segments.tr: Rilis pertama disebut **estimasi awal**.

segments.src: It arrives about a month after the quarter ends, which means it is built on incomplete information.
segments.tr: Ini tiba sekitar sebulan setelah kuartal berakhir, yang berarti dibangun di atas informasi yang tidak lengkap.

segments.src: Some source data are still being collected, and the BEA fills gaps with projections and statistical methods.
segments.tr: Beberapa data sumber masih dikumpulkan, dan BEA mengisi kesenjangan dengan proyeksi dan metode statistik.

segments.src: Two later updates, known as the second and third estimates, follow in the subsequent two months as more data come in.
segments.tr: Dua pembaruan kemudian, yang dikenal sebagai estimasi kedua dan ketiga, menyusul dalam dua bulan berikutnya seiring masuknya lebih banyak data.

segments.src: ## The four building blocks
segments.tr: ## Empat blok bangunan

segments.src: GDP is usually broken into four categories.
segments.tr: PDB biasanya dipecah menjadi empat kategori.

segments.src: Understanding each one makes the headline number far more useful.
segments.tr: Memahami masing-masing kategori membuat angka utama jauh lebih berguna.

segments.src: ### 1. Consumer spending
segments.tr: ### 1. Pengeluaran konsumen

segments.src: Household consumption is the largest piece of the economy, accounting for roughly two-thirds of GDP.
segments.tr: Konsumsi rumah tangga adalah bagian terbesar dari ekonomi, menyumbang sekitar dua pertiga dari PDB.

segments.src: Analysts look at:
segments.tr: Analis melihat:

segments.src: - **Goods versus services.** Spending on services such as travel, dining and health care tends to be steadier than spending on durable goods like cars and appliances.
segments.tr: - **Barang versus jasa.** Pengeluaran untuk jasa seperti perjalanan, makan di luar, dan perawatan kesehatan cenderung lebih stabil daripada pengeluaran untuk barang tahan lama seperti mobil dan peralatan rumah tangga.

segments.src: - **Real versus nominal.** The GDP figures are adjusted for inflation, so strong nominal spending can still translate into modest real growth if prices rose quickly.
segments.tr: - **Riil versus nominal.** Angka PDB disesuaikan untuk inflasi, jadi pengeluaran nominal yang kuat masih bisa diterjemahkan menjadi pertumbuhan riil yang moderat jika harga naik dengan cepat.

segments.src: - **Momentum within the quarter.** A strong July followed by a weaker September tells a different story than the reverse, even if the quarterly average looks the same.
segments.tr: - **Momentum dalam kuartal.** Juli yang kuat diikuti oleh September yang lebih lemah menceritakan kisah yang berbeda daripada sebaliknya, meskipun rata-rata kuartalan terlihat sama.

segments.src: ### 2. Business investment
segments.tr: ### 2. Investasi bisnis

segments.src: Also called nonresidential fixed investment, this category covers spending on equipment, software, intellectual property and structures.
segments.tr: Disebut juga investasi tetap non-residensial, kategori ini mencakup pengeluaran untuk peralatan, perangkat lunak, kekayaan intelektual, dan struktur.

segments.src: It is smaller than consumption but more volatile, and it often signals how confident companies feel about future demand.
segments.tr: Ini lebih kecil daripada konsumsi tetapi lebih fluktuatif, dan sering kali menandakan seberapa percaya diri perusahaan terhadap permintaan di masa depan.

segments.src: Pay attention to whether growth is concentrated in one area, such as technology equipment or data-center construction, or broadly shared across sectors.
segments.tr: Perhatikan apakah pertumbuhan terkonsentrasi di satu area, seperti peralatan teknologi atau pembangunan pusat data, atau tersebar luas di seluruh sektor.

segments.src: Residential investment, meaning home building and renovation, is tracked separately and tends to be sensitive to mortgage rates.
segments.tr: Investasi residensial, yang berarti pembangunan dan renovasi rumah, dilacak secara terpisah dan cenderung sensitif terhadap suku bunga hipotek.

segments.src: ### 3. Trade
segments.tr: ### 3. Perdagangan

segments.src: Net exports, which are exports minus imports, can swing the headline number sharply from one quarter to the next.
segments.tr: Ekspor neto, yaitu ekspor dikurangi impor, dapat mengayunkan angka utama secara tajam dari satu kuartal ke kuartal berikutnya.

segments.src: Imports subtract from GDP because they represent spending on goods produced elsewhere, so a surge in imports can pull down the topline even when domestic demand is healthy.
segments.tr: Impor mengurangi PDB karena mewakili pengeluaran untuk barang yang diproduksi di tempat lain, jadi lonjakan impor dapat menurunkan angka utama bahkan ketika permintaan domestik sehat.

segments.src: Shifts in tariffs, shipping patterns and company stockpiling can make this component especially noisy.
segments.tr: Perubahan tarif, pola pengiriman, dan penimbunan stok perusahaan dapat membuat komponen ini sangat bising.

segments.src: Many economists therefore treat a single quarter's trade contribution with caution.
segments.tr: Oleh karena itu, banyak ekonom memperlakukan kontribusi perdagangan satu kuartal dengan hati-hati.

segments.src: ### 4. Government spending
segments.tr: ### 4. Pengeluaran pemerintah

segments.src: Federal, state and local purchases round out the total.
segments.tr: Pembelian federal, negara bagian, dan lokal melengkapi totalnya.

segments.src: These figures are usually less dramatic, but defense outlays, infrastructure projects and the timing of budget decisions can move them noticeably.
segments.tr: Angka-angka ini biasanya tidak terlalu dramatis, tetapi pengeluaran pertahanan, proyek infrastruktur, dan waktu keputusan anggaran dapat menggerakkannya secara nyata.

segments.src: ## A useful shortcut: "final sales to private domestic purchasers"
segments.tr: ## Jalan pintas yang berguna: "penjualan akhir kepada pembeli domestik swasta"

segments.src: Because trade, inventories and government spending can add noise, many forecasters also watch a narrower measure that strips them out.
segments.tr: Karena perdagangan, persediaan, dan pengeluaran pemerintah dapat menambah kebisingan, banyak peramal juga melihat ukuran yang lebih sempit yang menghilangkannya.

segments.src: Final sales to private domestic purchasers combines consumer spending and private fixed investment.
segments.tr: Penjualan akhir kepada pembeli domestik swasta menggabungkan pengeluaran konsumen dan investasi tetap swasta.

segments.src: It is often considered a cleaner read on underlying demand, and it has historically been a better guide to where the economy is heading than the headline figure alone.
segments.tr: Ini sering dianggap sebagai pembacaan yang lebih bersih tentang permintaan yang mendasari, dan secara historis telah menjadi panduan yang lebih baik ke mana arah ekonomi daripada angka utama saja.

segments.src: Inventories deserve a mention as well.
segments.tr: Persediaan juga layak disebutkan.

segments.src: Changes in the stock of unsold goods can add to or subtract from growth in any given quarter, and those swings often reverse the following quarter.
segments.tr: Perubahan stok barang yang tidak terjual dapat menambah atau mengurangi pertumbuhan di kuartal mana pun, dan ayunan tersebut sering kali berbalik pada kuartal berikutnya.

segments.src: ## Why the headline number gets revised
segments.tr: ## Mengapa angka utama direvisi

segments.src: It is common for the first estimate to change, sometimes by a meaningful amount.
segments.tr: Adalah hal yang umum bagi estimasi pertama untuk berubah, terkadang dengan jumlah yang berarti.

segments.src: Several factors explain this:
segments.tr: Beberapa faktor menjelaskan hal ini:

segments.src: - **Incomplete data.** The advance estimate relies on partial surveys and early indicators that are updated later.
segments.tr: - **Data tidak lengkap.** Estimasi awal bergantung pada survei parsial dan indikator awal yang diperbarui kemudian.

segments.src: - **Seasonal and statistical adjustments.** Methods are refined as more information arrives.
segments.tr: - **Penyesuaian musiman dan statistik.** Metode disempurnakan seiring masuknya lebih banyak informasi.

segments.src: - **Annual and comprehensive updates.** The BEA periodically revises historical figures, which can alter the picture of growth well after the fact.
segments.tr: - **Pembaruan tahunan dan komprehensif.** BEA secara berkala merevisi angka historis, yang dapat mengubah gambaran pertumbuhan jauh setelah fakta terjadi.

segments.src: A revision does not mean the original number was careless.
segments.tr: Revisi tidak berarti angka aslinya ceroboh.

segments.src: It reflects the tradeoff between speed and completeness.
segments.tr: Ini mencerminkan pertukaran antara kecepatan dan kelengkapan.

segments.src: Users of the data generally accept an imperfect early read because timely information is valuable.
segments.tr: Pengguna data umumnya menerima pembacaan awal yang tidak sempurna karena informasi yang tepat waktu sangat berharga.

segments.src: The practical takeaway is to treat the first figure as a reasonable estimate with a margin of error, not a final verdict.
segments.tr: Pelajaran praktisnya adalah memperlakukan angka pertama sebagai estimasi yang masuk akal dengan margin kesalahan, bukan vonis akhir.

segments.src: ## Why the timing matters
segments.tr: ## Mengapa waktu penting

segments.src: The release lands in a busy stretch of the calendar.
segments.tr: Rilis ini mendarat di rentang waktu kalender yang sibuk.

segments.src: **The Federal Reserve.** Policymakers weigh growth, inflation and the labor market when deciding on interest rates.
segments.tr: **Federal Reserve.** Pembuat kebijakan mempertimbangkan pertumbuhan, inflasi, dan pasar tenaga kerja saat memutuskan suku bunga.

segments.src: A strong or weak GDP reading can shape the discussion, though the Fed typically looks at a wide range of data rather than a single report.
segments.tr: Pembacaan PDB yang kuat atau lemah dapat membentuk diskusi, meskipun The Fed biasanya melihat berbagai data daripada satu laporan saja.

segments.src: **The midterm elections.** Economic conditions are a regular theme in campaigns.
segments.tr: **Pemilihan paruh waktu.** Kondisi ekonomi adalah tema rutin dalam kampanye.

segments.src: Candidates and commentators on all sides tend to interpret the numbers through their own lens, which is one more reason to look at the components rather than the headline alone.
segments.tr: Kandidat dan komentator di semua sisi cenderung menafsirkan angka-angka melalui lensa mereka sendiri, yang merupakan satu alasan lagi untuk melihat komponen daripada angka utama saja.

segments.src: ## How to read the report like an analyst
segments.tr: ## Cara membaca laporan seperti seorang analis

segments.src: 1. **Look past the headline.** Check the contributions from consumption, investment, trade and inventories.
segments.tr: 1. **Lihat melampaui angka utama.** Periksa kontribusi dari konsumsi, investasi, perdagangan, dan persediaan.

segments.src: 2. **Compare with recent quarters.** One report is a data point, not a trend.
segments.tr: 2. **Bandingkan dengan kuartal terbaru.** Satu laporan adalah titik data, bukan tren.

segments.src: 3. **Watch the revisions.** Compare the advance estimate with later versions to understand how reliable early readings have been.
segments.tr: 3. **Perhatikan revisi.** Bandingkan estimasi awal dengan versi selanjutnya untuk memahami seberapa andal pembacaan awal tersebut.

segments.src: 4. **Pair GDP with other indicators.** Employment, inflation, retail sales and income data provide context that GDP alone cannot.
segments.tr: 4. **Pasangkan PDB dengan indikator lain.** Data ketenagakerjaan, inflasi, penjualan ritel, dan pendapatan memberikan konteks yang tidak bisa diberikan oleh PDB saja.

segments.src: 5. **Remember that GDP is a backward-looking measure.** It describes what already happened, not what comes next.
segments.tr: 5. **Ingat bahwa PDB adalah ukuran yang melihat ke belakang.** Ini menggambarkan apa yang sudah terjadi, bukan apa yang akan datang.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Intinya

segments.src: The advance estimate of third-quarter GDP offers a valuable first look at the economy's health, but it is a snapshot, not a final grade.
segments.tr: Estimasi awal PDB kuartal ketiga menawarkan pandangan pertama yang berharga tentang kesehatan ekonomi, tetapi ini adalah potret, bukan nilai akhir.

segments.src: The most informative details sit beneath the headline, in how households spent, how businesses invested and how trade shifted.
segments.tr: Detail yang paling informatif terletak di bawah angka utama, dalam bagaimana rumah tangga membelanjakan uang, bagaimana bisnis berinvestasi, dan bagaimana perdagangan bergeser.

segments.src: Readers who focus on those components, and who keep in mind that revisions are normal, will come away with a clearer and more balanced understanding of where the economy stands.
segments.tr: Pembaca yang fokus pada komponen-komponen tersebut, dan yang mengingat bahwa revisi adalah hal yang normal, akan mendapatkan pemahaman yang lebih jelas dan lebih seimbang tentang posisi ekonomi saat ini.

segments.tr: *Artikel ini hanya untuk tujuan informasi umum dan bukan merupakan nasihat keuangan, investasi, atau kebijakan.*

segments.src: The first official estimate of third-quarter economic growth is due in the final days of October, arriving just ahead of the Federal Reserve's next policy meeting and the November midterm elections.
segments.tr: 第3四半期的経済成長率の最初の公式推計値は10月の最終日頃に発表される予定であり、米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）の次回政策金利会合や11月の中間選挙の直前に到着する。

segments.src: The release is one of the most closely watched data points of the year.
segments.tr: この発表は、年間で最も注目されるデータポイントの1つである。

segments.src: It is also one of the most frequently misread.
segments.tr: また、最も誤読されやすいデータの1つでもある。

segments.src: This guide explains what the number measures, which components deserve the most attention, and why the first figure is only the opening chapter of a longer story.
segments.tr: 本ガイドでは、この数値が何を測定しているのか、どの構成要素に最も注目すべきか、そして最初の数値がより長い物語の最初の章にすぎない理由について解説する。

segments.src: ## What the "advance estimate" actually is
segments.tr: ## "速報値"の実際の内容

segments.src: Gross domestic product, or GDP, is the broadest measure of the goods and services produced in the United States.
segments.tr: 国内総生産（GDP）は、米国で生産された財とサービスの最も広範な尺度である。

segments.src: The Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA), part of the Commerce Department, publishes it every quarter, and the headline figure is typically presented as an annualized rate.
segments.tr: 商務省の一部局である経済分析局（BEA）が四半期ごとに発表しており、見出しとなる数値は通常、年率換算値として提示される。

segments.src: That means the quarterly change is expressed as if the pace continued for a full year.
segments.tr: つまり、四半期の変化が、そのペースが丸1年間続いたかのように表現されるということである。

segments.src: The first release is called the **advance estimate**.
segments.tr: 最初の発表は**速報値（advance estimate）**と呼ばれる。

segments.src: It arrives about a month after the quarter ends, which means it is built on incomplete information.
segments.tr: 四半期終了から約1か月後に発表されるため、不完全な情報に基づいて構築されていることを意味する。

segments.src: Some source data are still being collected, and the BEA fills gaps with projections and statistical methods.
segments.tr: 一部の基礎データはまだ収集中であり、BEAは予測や統計的手法でその隙間を埋めている。

segments.src: Two later updates, known as the second and third estimates, follow in the subsequent two months as more data come in.
segments.tr: より多くのデータが入手されるにつれて、第2次推計値、第3次推計値と呼ばれる2つの後続の更新がその後の2か月間に行われる。

segments.src: ## The four building blocks
segments.tr: ## 4つの構成要素

segments.src: GDP is usually broken into four categories.
segments.tr: GDPは通常、4つのカテゴリに分解される。

segments.src: Understanding each one makes the headline number far more useful.
segments.tr: それぞれのカテゴリを理解することで、見出しの数値がはるかに有用なものとなる。

segments.src: ### 1. Consumer spending
segments.tr: ### 1. 個人消費

segments.src: Household consumption is the largest piece of the economy, accounting for roughly two-thirds of GDP.
segments.tr: 家計消費は経済最大の構成要素であり、GDPのおよそ3分の2を占めている。

segments.src: Analysts look at:
segments.tr: アナリストは以下に注目する：

segments.src: - **Goods versus services.** Spending on services such as travel, dining and health care tends to be steadier than spending on durable goods like cars and appliances.
segments.tr: - **財とサービス。** 旅行、外食、医療などのサービスへの支出は、自動車や家電などの耐久財への支出よりも安定している傾向がある。

segments.src: - **Real versus nominal.** The GDP figures are adjusted for inflation, so strong nominal spending can still translate into modest real growth if prices rose quickly.
segments.tr: - **実質と名目。** GDPの数値はインフレ調整されているため、物価が急上昇した場合、強い名目支出であっても控えめな実質成長率にしかつながらないことがある。

segments.src: - **Momentum within the quarter.** A strong July followed by a weaker September tells a different story than the reverse, even if the quarterly average looks the same.
segments.tr: - **四半期内のモメンタム。** 四半期の平均が同じに見えても、好調な7月の後に低調な9月が続くのとその逆では、物語が異なる。

segments.src: ### 2. Business investment
segments.tr: ### 2. 企業投資

segments.src: Also called nonresidential fixed investment, this category covers spending on equipment, software, intellectual property and structures.
segments.tr: 非住宅固定投資とも呼ばれ、このカテゴリは設備、ソフトウェア、知的財産、建造物への支出をカバーしている。

segments.src: It is smaller than consumption but more volatile, and it often signals how confident companies feel about future demand.
segments.tr: 消費よりも規模は小さいがボラティリティが高く、将来の需要に対して企業がどれほどの自信を感じているかを示すことが多い。

segments.src: Pay attention to whether growth is concentrated in one area, such as technology equipment or data-center construction, or broadly shared across sectors.
segments.tr: 成長がハイテク機器やデータセンター建設などの特定の分野に集中しているのか、それともセクター全体に広く共有されているのかに注目すべきである。

segments.src: Residential investment, meaning home building and renovation, is tracked separately and tends to be sensitive to mortgage rates.
segments.tr: 住宅投資（住宅建設やリノベーションを意味する）は別個に追跡され、住宅ローン金利に敏感である傾向がある。

segments.src: ### 3. Trade
Net exports, which are exports minus imports, can swing the headline number sharply from one quarter to the next.
segments.tr: 純輸出（輸出から輸入を引いたもの）は、ある四半期から次の四半期にかけて見出しの数値を大きく変動させる可能性がある。

segments.src: Imports subtract from GDP because they represent spending on goods produced elsewhere, so a surge in imports can pull down the topline even when domestic demand is healthy.
segments.tr: 輸入は他国で生産された財への支出を表すためGDPからマイナスされ、したがって国内需要が健全であっても輸入の急増が全体の数値を押し下げる可能性がある。

segments.src: Shifts in tariffs, shipping patterns and company stockpiling can make this component especially noisy.
segments.tr: 関税の変化、出荷のパターン、企業の在庫蓄積により、この構成要素は特にノイズが多くなり得る。

segments.src: Many economists therefore treat a single quarter's trade contribution with caution.
segments.tr: そのため、多くの経済学者は1四半期の貿易の貢献度を慎重に扱う。

segments.src: ### 4. Government spending
segments.tr: ### 4. 政府支出

segments.src: Federal, state and local purchases round out the total.
segments.tr: 連邦、州、地方政府の購入が全体を締めくくる。

segments.src: These figures are usually less dramatic, but defense outlays, infrastructure projects and the timing of budget decisions can move them noticeably.
segments.tr: これらの数値は通常それほど劇的ではないが、防衛費支出、インフラプロジェクト、予算決定のタイミングによって顕著に変動することがある。

segments.src: ## A useful shortcut: "final sales to private domestic purchasers"
segments.tr: ## 便利な近道：「国内民間購入者向け最終販売」

segments.src: Because trade, inventories and government spending can add noise, many forecasters also watch a narrower measure that strips them out.
segments.tr: 貿易、在庫、政府支出はノイズを加える可能性があるため、多くの予測担当者はそれらを除外したより狭い尺度も注視している。

segments.src: Final sales to private domestic purchasers combines consumer spending and private fixed investment.
segments.tr: 国内民間購入者向け最終販売は、個人消費と民間固定投資を組み合わせたものである。

segments.src: It is often considered a cleaner read on underlying demand, and it has historically been a better guide to where the economy is heading than the headline figure alone.
segments.tr: これは基調的な需要のよりクリーンな読み方と見なされることが多く、歴史的に、見出しの数値単独よりも経済の向かう先をよりよく示す指針となってきた。

segments.src: Inventories deserve a mention as well.
segments.tr: 在庫についても言及に値する。

segments.src: Changes in the stock of unsold goods can add to or subtract from growth in any given quarter, and those swings often reverse the following quarter.
segments.tr: 売れ残り財の在庫の変化は、どの四半期においても成長を押し上げたり押し下げたりすることがあり、それらの振れは次の四半期に逆転することが多い。

segments.src: ## Why the headline number gets revised
segments.tr: ## 見出しの数値が修正される理由

segments.src: It is common for the first estimate to change, sometimes by a meaningful amount.
segments.tr: 最初の推計値が変更される、それも時には意味のある幅で変更されることはよくあることである。

segments.src: Several factors explain this:
segments.tr: これにはいくつかの要因がある：

segments.src: - **Incomplete data.** The advance estimate relies on partial surveys and early indicators that are updated later.
segments.tr: - **不完全なデータ。** 速報値は、後日更新される部分的な調査や早期の指標に依存している。

segments.src: - **Seasonal and statistical adjustments.** Methods are refined as more information arrives.
segments.tr: - **季節的および統計的調整。** より多くの情報が入るにつれて手法が洗練される。

segments.src: - **Annual and comprehensive updates.** The BEA periodically revises historical figures, which can alter the picture of growth well after the fact.

segments.tr: Die erste offizielle Schätzung des Wirtschaftswachstums im dritten Quartal wird in den letzten Oktobertagen erwartet, kurz vor der nächsten geldpolitischen Sitzung der Federal Reserve und den Zwischenwahlen im November.

segments.src: The release is one of the most closely watched data points of the year.
segments.tr: Die Veröffentlichung ist einer der am genauesten beobachteten Datenpunkte des Jahres.

segments.src: It is also one of the most frequently misread.
segments.tr: Sie ist auch einer der am häufigsten falsch interpretierten.

segments.src: This guide explains what the number measures, which components deserve the most attention, and why the first figure is only the opening chapter of a longer story.
segments.tr: Dieser Leitfaden erklärt, was die Zahl misst, welche Komponenten die meiste Aufmerksamkeit verdienen und warum die erste Zahl nur das erste Kapitel einer längeren Geschichte ist.

segments.src: ## What the "advance estimate" actually is
segments.tr: ## Was die „vorläufige Schätzung“ eigentlich ist

segments.src: Gross domestic product, or GDP, is the broadest measure of the goods and services produced in the United States.
segments.tr: Das Bruttoinlandsprodukt, oder BIP, ist das umfassendste Maß für die in den Vereinigten Staaten produzierten Waren und Dienstleistungen.

segments.src: The Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA), part of the Commerce Department, publishes it every quarter, and the headline figure is typically presented as an annualized rate.
segments.tr: Das Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA), ein Teil des Handelsministeriums, veröffentlicht es jedes Quartal, und die Schlagzeilenzahl wird typischerweise als annualisierte Rate dargestellt.

segments.src: That means the quarterly change is expressed as if the pace continued for a full year.
segments.tr: Das bedeutet, die vierteljährliche Veränderung wird so ausgedrückt, als ob das Tempo ein ganzes Jahr lang anhalten würde.

segments.src: The first release is called the **advance estimate**.
segments.tr: Die erste Veröffentlichung wird als **vorläufige Schätzung** (advance estimate) bezeichnet.

segments.src: It arrives about a month after the quarter ends, which means it is built on incomplete information.
segments.tr: Sie erscheint etwa einen Monat nach Quartalsende, was bedeutet, dass sie auf unvollständigen Informationen basiert.

segments.src: Some source data are still being collected, and the BEA fills gaps with projections and statistical methods.
segments.tr: Einige Quelldaten werden noch erhoben, und das BEA füllt Lücken mit Prognosen und statistischen Methoden.

segments.src: Two later updates, known as the second and third estimates, follow in the subsequent two months as more data come in.
segments.tr: Zwei spätere Aktualisierungen, bekannt als zweite und dritte Schätzung, folgen in den darauffolgenden zwei Monaten, sobald mehr Daten eingehen.

segments.src: ## The four building blocks
segments.tr: ## Die vier Bausteine

segments.src: GDP is usually broken into four categories.
segments.tr: Das BIP wird üblicherweise in vier Kategorien unterteilt.

segments.src: Understanding each one makes the headline number far more useful.
segments.tr: Das Verständnis jeder einzelnen macht die Schlagzeilenzahl weitaus nützlicher.

segments.src: ### 1. Consumer spending
segments.tr: ### 1. Konsumausgaben

segments.src: Household consumption is the largest piece of the economy, accounting for roughly two-thirds of GDP.
segments.tr: Der private Konsum ist der größte Teil der Wirtschaft und macht etwa zwei Drittel des BIP aus.

segments.src: Analysts look at:
segments.tr: Analysten betrachten:

segments.src: - **Goods versus services.** Spending on services such as travel, dining and health care tends to be steadier than spending on durable goods like cars and appliances.
segments.tr: - **Waren versus Dienstleistungen.** Ausgaben für Dienstleistungen wie Reisen, Gastronomie und Gesundheitswesen sind tendenziell stabiler als Ausgaben für langlebige Güter wie Autos und Haushaltsgeräte.

segments.src: - **Real versus nominal.** The GDP figures are adjusted for inflation, so strong nominal spending can still translate into modest real growth if prices rose quickly.
segments.tr: - **Real versus nominal.** Die BIP-Zahlen sind inflationsbereinigt, daher können starke nominale Ausgaben immer noch ein moderates reales Wachstum bedeuten, wenn die Preise schnell gestiegen sind.

segments.src: - **Momentum within the quarter.** A strong July followed by a weaker September tells a different story than the reverse, even if the quarterly average looks the same.
segments.tr: - **Dynamik innerhalb des Quartals.** Ein starker Juli gefolgt von einem schwächeren September erzählt eine andere Geschichte als umgekehrt, selbst wenn der Quartalsdurchschnitt gleich aussieht.

segments.src: ### 2. Business investment
segments.tr: ### 2. Unternehmensinvestitionen

segments.src: Also called nonresidential fixed investment, this category covers spending on equipment, software, intellectual property and structures.
segments.tr: Auch als nicht-wohnwirtschaftliche Anlageinvestitionen bezeichnet, deckt diese Kategorie Ausgaben für Ausrüstung, Software, geistiges Eigentum und Strukturen ab.

segments.src: It is smaller than consumption but more volatile, and it often signals how confident companies feel about future demand.
segments.tr: Sie ist kleiner als der Konsum, aber volatiler, und signalisiert oft, wie zuversichtlich Unternehmen hinsichtlich der zukünftigen Nachfrage sind.

segments.src: Pay attention to whether growth is concentrated in one area, such as technology equipment or data-center construction, or broadly shared across sectors.
segments.tr: Achten Sie darauf, ob sich das Wachstum auf einen Bereich konzentriert, wie etwa Technologieausrüstung oder den Bau von Rechenzentren, oder ob es breit über die Sektoren verteilt ist.

segments.src: Residential investment, meaning home building and renovation, is tracked separately and tends to be sensitive to mortgage rates.
segments.tr: Wohnungsbauinvestitionen, also Hausbau und Renovierung, werden separat erfasst und reagieren tendenziell empfindlich auf Hypothekenzinsen.

segments.src: ### 3. Trade
segments.tr: ### 3. Handel

segments.src: Net exports, which are exports minus imports, can swing the headline number sharply from one quarter to the next.
segments.tr: Nettoexporte, also Exporte abzüglich Importe, können die Schlagzeilenzahl von einem Quartal zum nächsten stark beeinflussen.

segments.src: Imports subtract from GDP because they represent spending on goods produced elsewhere, so a surge in imports can pull down the topline even when domestic demand is healthy.
segments.tr: Importe werden vom BIP abgezogen, da sie Ausgaben für anderswo produzierte Waren darstellen; ein Anstieg der Importe kann also die Gesamtzahl nach unten ziehen, selbst wenn die Binnennachfrage gesund ist.

segments.src: Shifts in tariffs, shipping patterns and company stockpiling can make this component especially noisy.
segments.tr: Verschiebungen bei Zöllen, Versandmustern und Lagerhaltung der Unternehmen können diese Komponente besonders störanfällig machen.

segments.src: Many economists therefore treat a single quarter's trade contribution with caution.
segments.tr: Viele Ökonomen betrachten daher den Handelsbeitrag eines einzelnen Quartals mit Vorsicht.

segments.src: ### 4. Government spending
segments.tr: ### 4. Staatsausgaben

segments.src: Federal, state and local purchases round out the total.
segments.tr: Käufe von Bund, Ländern und Kommunen runden die Gesamtsumme ab.

segments.src: These figures are usually less dramatic, but defense outlays, infrastructure projects and the timing of budget decisions can move them noticeably.
segments.tr: Diese Zahlen sind meist weniger dramatisch, aber Verteidigungsausgaben, Infrastrukturprojekte und der Zeitpunkt von Haushaltsentscheidungen können sie spürbar bewegen.

segments.src: ## A useful shortcut: "final sales to private domestic purchasers"
segments.tr: ## Eine nützliche Abkürzung: „Endverkäufe an private inländische Käufer“

segments.src: Because trade, inventories and government spending can add noise, many forecasters also watch a narrower measure that strips them out.
segments.tr: Da Handel, Lagerbestände und Staatsausgaben für Rauschen sorgen können, beobachten viele Prognostiker auch ein engeres Maß, das diese herausrechnet.

segments.src: Final sales to private domestic purchasers combines consumer spending and private fixed investment.
segments.tr: Endverkäufe an private inländische Käufer kombinieren Konsumausgaben und private Anlageinvestitionen.

segments.src: It is often considered a cleaner read on underlying demand, and it has historically been a better guide to where the economy is heading than the headline figure alone.
segments.tr: Es wird oft als klarerer Indikator für die zugrunde liegende Nachfrage angesehen und war historisch gesehen ein besserer Wegweiser für die Richtung der Wirtschaft als die Schlagzeilenzahl allein.

segments.src: Inventories deserve a mention as well.
segments.tr: Lagerbestände verdienen ebenfalls eine Erwähnung.

segments.src: Changes in the stock of unsold goods can add to or subtract from growth in any given quarter, and those swings often reverse the following quarter.
segments.tr: Veränderungen im Bestand an unverkauften Waren können das Wachstum in jedem Quartal erhöhen oder verringern, und diese Schwankungen kehren sich oft im folgenden Quartal um.

segments.src: ## Why the headline number gets revised
segments.tr: ## Warum die Schlagzeilenzahl revidiert wird

segments.src: It is common for the first estimate to change, sometimes by a meaningful amount.
segments.tr: Es ist üblich, dass sich die erste Schätzung ändert, manchmal um einen bedeutenden Betrag.

segments.src: Several factors explain this:
segments.tr: Mehrere Faktoren erklären dies:

segments.src: - **Incomplete data.** The advance estimate relies on partial surveys and early indicators that are updated later.
segments.tr: - **Unvollständige Daten.** Die vorläufige Schätzung stützt sich auf Teilumfragen und Frühindikatoren, die später aktualisiert werden.

segments.src: - **Seasonal and statistical adjustments.** Methods are refined as more information arrives.
segments.tr: - **Saisonale und statistische Anpassungen.** Methoden werden verfeinert, sobald mehr Informationen eingehen.

segments.src: - **Annual and comprehensive updates.** The BEA periodically revises historical figures, which can alter the picture of growth well after the fact.
segments.tr: - **Jährliche und umfassende Aktualisierungen.** Das BEA überarbeitet regelmäßig historische Zahlen, was das Bild des Wachstums noch lange nach dem Ereignis verändern kann.

segments.src: A revision does not mean the original number was careless.
segments.tr: Eine Revision bedeutet nicht, dass die ursprüngliche Zahl sorglos war.

segments.src: It reflects the tradeoff between speed and completeness.
segments.tr: Sie spiegelt den Kompromiss zwischen Geschwindigkeit und Vollständigkeit wider.

segments.src: Users of the data generally accept an imperfect early read because timely information is valuable.
segments.tr: Nutzer der Daten akzeptieren im Allgemeinen eine unvollkommene frühe Schätzung, weil zeitnahe Informationen wertvoll sind.

segments.src: The practical takeaway is to treat the first figure as a reasonable estimate with a margin of error, not a final verdict.
segments.tr: Die praktische Schlussfolgerung ist, die erste Zahl als vernünftige Schätzung mit einer Fehlerspanne zu betrachten, nicht als endgültiges Urteil.

segments.tr: Hiểu được từng danh mục sẽ làm cho con số chính trở nên hữu ích hơn rất nhiều.

segments.src: ### 1. Consumer spending
segments.tr: ### 1. Chi tiêu tiêu dùng

segments.src: Household consumption is the largest piece of the economy, accounting for roughly two-thirds of GDP.
segments.tr: Tiêu dùng hộ gia đình là phần lớn nhất của nền kinh tế, chiếm khoảng 2/3 GDP.

segments.src: Analysts look at:
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích xem xét:

segments.src: - **Goods versus services.** Spending on services such as travel, dining and health care tends to be steadier than spending on durable goods like cars and appliances.
segments.tr: - **Hàng hóa so với dịch vụ.** Chi tiêu cho các dịch vụ như du lịch, ăn uống và chăm sóc sức khỏe có xu hướng ổn định hơn chi tiêu cho hàng hóa bền như ô tô và thiết bị gia dụng.

segments.src: - **Real versus nominal.** The GDP figures are adjusted for inflation, so strong nominal spending can still translate into modest real growth if prices rose quickly.
segments.tr: - **Thực tế so với danh nghĩa.** Các số liệu GDP được điều chỉnh theo lạm phát, vì vậy chi tiêu danh nghĩa mạnh mẽ vẫn có thể chuyển thành tăng trưởng thực tế khiêm tốn nếu giá cả tăng nhanh.

segments.src: - **Momentum within the quarter.** A strong July followed by a weaker September tells a different story than the reverse, even if the quarterly average looks the same.
segments.tr: - **Động lực trong quý.** Tháng 7 mạnh mẽ theo sau bởi tháng 9 yếu hơn sẽ kể một câu chuyện khác so với chiều ngược lại, ngay cả khi mức trung bình hàng quý trông giống nhau.

segments.src: ### 2. Business investment
segments.tr: ### 2. Đầu tư kinh doanh

segments.src: Also called nonresidential fixed investment, this category covers spending on equipment, software, intellectual property and structures.
segments.tr: Còn được gọi là đầu tư cố định phi dân cư, danh mục này bao gồm chi tiêu cho thiết bị, phần mềm, tài sản trí tuệ và cấu trúc.

segments.src: It is smaller than consumption but more volatile, and it often signals how confident companies feel about future demand.
segments.tr: Nó nhỏ hơn tiêu dùng nhưng biến động mạnh hơn, và nó thường báo hiệu mức độ tự tin của các công ty về nhu cầu trong tương lai.

segments.src: Pay attention to whether growth is concentrated in one area, such as technology equipment or data-center construction, or broadly shared across sectors.
segments.tr: Hãy chú ý xem liệu tăng trưởng có tập trung vào một lĩnh vực nào đó, chẳng hạn như thiết bị công nghệ hoặc xây dựng trung tâm dữ liệu, hay được chia sẻ rộng rãi giữa các ngành.

segments.src: Residential investment, meaning home building and renovation, is tracked separately and tends to be sensitive to mortgage rates.
segments.tr: Đầu tư dân cư, có nghĩa là xây dựng nhà ở và cải tạo, được theo dõi riêng biệt và có xu hướng nhạy cảm với lãi suất thế chấp.

segments.src: ### 3. Trade
segments.tr: ### 3. Thương mại

segments.src: Net exports, which are exports minus imports, can swing the headline number sharply from one quarter to the next.
segments.tr: Xuất khẩu ròng, là xuất khẩu trừ đi nhập khẩu, có thể làm thay đổi mạnh mẽ con số chính từ quý này sang quý khác.

segments.src: Imports subtract from GDP because they represent spending on goods produced elsewhere, so a surge in imports can pull down the topline even when domestic demand is healthy.
segments.tr: Nhập khẩu làm giảm GDP vì chúng đại diện cho chi tiêu cho hàng hóa được sản xuất ở nơi khác, do đó sự gia tăng mạnh mẽ về nhập khẩu có thể kéo giảm tổng doanh thu ngay cả khi nhu cầu trong nước đang khỏe mạnh.

segments.src: Shifts in tariffs, shipping patterns and company stockpiling can make this component especially noisy.
segments.tr: Sự thay đổi về thuế quan, mô hình vận chuyển và việc tích trữ hàng hóa của công ty có thể làm cho thành phần này trở nên ồn ào đặc biệt.

segments.src: Many economists therefore treat a single quarter's trade contribution with caution.
segments.tr: Do đó, nhiều nhà kinh tế coi đóng góp thương mại của một quý đơn lẻ với sự thận trọng.

segments.src: ### 4. Government spending
segments.tr: ### 4. Chi tiêu chính phủ

segments.src: Federal, state and local purchases round out the total.
segments.tr: Các giao dịch mua sắm của liên bang, tiểu bang và địa phương hoàn thiện tổng số.

segments.src: These figures are usually less dramatic, but defense outlays, infrastructure projects and the timing of budget decisions can move them noticeably.
segments.tr: Những số liệu này thường ít kịch tính hơn, nhưng chi tiêu quốc phòng, các dự án cơ sở hạ tầng và thời gian quyết định ngân sách có thể làm thay đổi chúng đáng kể.

segments.src: ## A useful shortcut: "final sales to private domestic purchasers"
segments.tr: ## Một phím tắt hữu ích: "tổng doanh số bán hàng cho người mua trong nước tư nhân"

segments.src: Because trade, inventories and government spending can add noise, many forecasters also watch a narrower measure that strips them out.
segments.tr: Vì thương mại, hàng tồn kho và chi tiêu chính phủ có thể tạo ra tiếng ồn, nhiều nhà dự báo cũng theo dõi một thước đo hẹp hơn loại bỏ chúng ra.

segments.src: Final sales to private domestic purchasers combines consumer spending and private fixed investment.
segments.tr: Tổng doanh số bán hàng cho người mua trong nước tư nhân kết hợp chi tiêu tiêu dùng và đầu tư cố định tư nhân.

segments.src: It is often considered a cleaner read on underlying demand, and it has historically been a better guide to where the economy is heading than the headline figure alone.
segments.tr: Nó thường được coi là một bản đọc sạch hơn về nhu cầu cơ bản, và trước đây nó là một hướng dẫn tốt hơn về nơi nền kinh tế đang hướng tới so với chỉ số chính.

segments.src: Inventories deserve a mention as well.
segments.tr: Hàng tồn kho cũng xứng đáng được nhắc đến.

segments.src: Changes in the stock of unsold goods can add to or subtract from growth in any given quarter, and those swings often reverse the following quarter.
segments.tr: Sự thay đổi trong kho hàng chưa bán có thể làm tăng hoặc giảm tăng trưởng trong bất kỳ quý nào cho trước, và những biến động đó thường đảo ngược vào quý tiếp theo.

segments.src: ## Why the headline number gets revised
segments.tr: ## Tại sao con số chính lại được điều chỉnh

segments.src: It is common for the first estimate to change, sometimes by a meaningful amount.
segments.tr: Việc ước tính đầu tiên thay đổi là điều bình thường, đôi khi với một lượng đáng kể.

segments.src: Several factors explain this:
segments.tr: Một số yếu tố giải thích điều này:

segments.src: - **Incomplete data.** The advance estimate relies on partial surveys and early indicators that are updated later.
segments.tr: - **Dữ liệu chưa đầy đủ.** Ước tính sơ bộ dựa trên các cuộc khảo sát một phần và các chỉ số sớm được cập nhật sau đó.

segments.src: - **Seasonal and statistical adjustments.** Methods are refined as more information arrives.
segments.tr: - **Điều chỉnh theo mùa và thống kê.** Các phương pháp được tinh chỉnh khi có thêm thông tin đến.

segments.src: - **Annual and comprehensive updates.** The BEA periodically revises historical figures, which can alter the picture of growth well after the fact.
segments.tr: - **Cập nhật hàng năm và toàn diện.** BEA định kỳ sửa đổi các số liệu lịch sử, điều này có thể thay đổi bức tranh tăng trưởng rất lâu sau sự kiện.

segments.src: A revision does not mean the original number was careless.
segments.tr: Việc sửa đổi không có nghĩa là con số ban đầu là bất cẩn.

segments.src: It reflects the tradeoff between speed and completeness.
segments.tr: Nó phản ánh sự đánh đổi giữa tốc độ và tính đầy đủ.

segments.src: Users of the data generally accept an imperfect early read because timely information is valuable.
segments.tr: Người dùng dữ liệu thường chấp nhận một bản đọc sớm không hoàn hảo vì thông tin kịp thời có giá trị.

segments.src: The practical takeaway is to treat the first figure as a reasonable estimate with a margin of error, not a final verdict.
segments.tr: Bài học thực tế là coi con số đầu tiên như một ước tính hợp lý với biên độ sai số, chứ không phải là phán quyết cuối cùng.

segments.src: ## Why the timing matters
segments.tr: ## Tại sao thời gian lại quan trọng

segments.src: The release lands in a busy stretch of the calendar.
segments.tr: Bản phát hành rơi vào một khoảng thời gian bận rộn của lịch.

segments.src: **The Federal Reserve.** Policymakers weigh growth, inflation and the labor market when deciding on interest rates.
segments.tr: **Cục Dự trữ Liên bang.** Các nhà hoạch định chính sách cân nhắc tăng trưởng, lạm phát và thị trường lao động khi quyết định lãi suất.

segments.src: A strong or weak GDP reading can shape the discussion, though the Fed typically looks at a wide range of data rather than a single report.
segments.tr: Một kết quả đọc GDP mạnh mẽ hoặc yếu có thể định hình cuộc thảo luận, mặc dù Fed thường xem xét một loạt các dữ liệu rộng hơn là một báo cáo duy nhất.

segments.src: **The midterm elections.** Economic conditions are a regular theme in campaigns.
segments.tr: **Cuộc bầu cử giữa nhiệm kỳ.** Điều kiện kinh tế là một chủ đề thường xuyên trong các chiến dịch tranh cử.

segments.src: Candidates and commentators on all sides tend to interpret the numbers through their own lens, which is one more reason to look at the components rather than the headline alone.
segments.tr: Các ứng cử viên và nhà bình luận ở mọi phía có xu hướng diễn giải các con số qua lăng kính của riêng họ, đó là lý do nữa để xem xét các thành phần thay vì chỉ số chính.

segments.src: ## How to read the report like an analyst
segments.tr: ## Cách đọc báo cáo như một nhà phân tích

segments.src: 1. **Look past the headline.** Check the contributions from consumption, investment, trade and inventories.
segments.tr: 1. **Nhìn vượt qua tiêu đề.** Kiểm tra sự đóng góp từ tiêu dùng, đầu tư, thương mại và hàng tồn kho.

segments.src: 2. **Compare with recent quarters.** One report is a data point, not a trend.
segments.tr: 2. **So sánh với các quý gần đây.** Một báo cáo là một điểm dữ liệu, không phải là một xu hướng.

segments.src: 3. **Watch the revisions.** Compare the advance estimate with later versions to understand how reliable early readings have been.
segments.tr: 3. **Theo dõi các bản sửa đổi.** So sánh ước tính sơ bộ với các phiên bản sau để hiểu mức độ đáng tin cậy của các chỉ số đọc sớm.

segments.src: 4. **Pair GDP with other indicators.** Employment, inflation, retail sales and income data provide context that GDP alone cannot.
segments.tr: 4. **Kết hợp GDP với các chỉ số khác.** Việc làm, lạm phát, doanh thu bán lẻ và dữ liệu thu nhập cung cấp bối cảnh mà chỉ riêng GDP không thể có.

segments.src: 5. **Remember that GDP is a backward-looking measure.** It describes what already happened, not what comes next.
segments.tr: 5. **Nhớ rằng GDP là thước đo hướng về phía sau.** Nó mô tả những gì đã xảy ra, không phải những gì tiếp theo.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Điểm mấu chốt

segments.src: The advance estimate of third-quarter GDP offers a valuable first look at the economy's health, but it is a snapshot, not a final grade.
segments.tr: Ước tính sơ bộ về GDP quý 3 cung cấp một cái nhìn đầu tiên có giá trị về sức khỏe của nền kinh tế, nhưng nó là một bức ảnh chụp nhanh, không phải là điểm số cuối cùng.

segments.src: The most informative details sit beneath the headline, in how households spent, how businesses invested and how trade shifted.
segments.tr: Các chi tiết nhiều thông tin nhất nằm bên dưới tiêu đề, trong cách các hộ gia đình chi tiêu, cách các doanh nghiệp đầu tư và cách thương mại thay đổi.

segments.src: Readers who focus on those components, and who keep in mind that revisions are normal, will come away with a clearer and more balanced understanding of where the economy stands.
segments.tr: Những độc giả tập trung vào các thành phần đó, và ghi nhớ rằng việc sửa đổi là bình thường, sẽ có được sự hiểu biết rõ ràng và cân bằng hơn về vị trí của nền kinh tế.
